Start: Golgari Thug (battlefield); Bolas's Citadel (battlefield); Carrion Feeder (battlefield); Vein Ripper (battlefield)

Color identity: B | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 3 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite lifeloss; Infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite storm count
Start: Mortuary (battlefield); Carrion Feeder (battlefield); Venerated Stormsinger (battlefield); Gwenom, Remorseless (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Gwenom has attacked this turn.
Steps: Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
  When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
  Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
  Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
  Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
  Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
  Repeat.

  Repeat.

Color identity: B | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 920 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}
Produces: Near-infinite lifeloss for all players
Start: Pox Plague (hand); Wound Reflection (battlefield)
Steps: Cast Pox Plague by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}, causing each player to lose half their life, discard half their hand, and sacrifice half their permanents, rounded down. Ensure that you don't sacrifice Wound Reflection.
  At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
Notes: Each opponent with an odd life total will have 1 life remaining. Each opponent with an even life total will have 0 life and lose the game.

Start: Phantom Train (battlefield); Darksteel Angel (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with persist.

  Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
  Repeat.
